method.source: TradingView OANDA:XAUUSD, archived OHLC merged with latest fetched completed candles
method.grid: 165 reference-anchored pairs; first 0–25%, second greater than first through 50%, at 2.5 percentage-point steps. Percentage of final confirmation candle BODY, not whole pattern/wicks.
method.invariant: Original fixed SL/TP, 60/40 risk split, 75-minute entry deadline, same 235 qualified setups. BUY entries below and SELL above reference. Old method is retained as next-open-anchored comparator.
method.fills: Both-filled requires both entries confirmed on every allowed OHLC path. Fill certainty is separate from exit certainty. Denominator is every eligible archived setup, including missing-data setups, not only winning or filled trades.
method.selection: August–September training only. For 85%, 90%, 95% both-fill targets, maximize known-result net R, requiring at least baseline training win rate, positive pessimistic training R bound and 70% of baseline closed-trade count. Also report maximum training fill rate under those safeguards.
method.validation: October 1–November 18 chronological comparison, 111 setups; training 124 setups ends at October 1. The same later-period data were reviewed in earlier studies, so this is reused validation and not independent unseen evidence.
method.cash: Illustrative fixed $4 total risk per setup, 60/40 allocation, ideal fractional lots, no compounding. Entire uncertain/open setup outcomes excluded from main P&L. No spread, fees, slippage, margin, overlap risk reductions, daily limits or concurrent-order constraints. Current Exness minimum/step .01 and contract 100 oz are checked separately with second-only fallback.
method.pips: 1 gold pip=.10 price units; unweighted sum over filled legs in entirely resolved setups. Dollar totals use risk-based sizing, so pips and dollars are different measures.
method.uncertainty: TP/SL and win rate exclude uncertain exits, unfilled and invalid entries. Lower/upper R bounds retain unresolved outcomes conservatively. Trades sharing candles can be correlated; bounds are loose rather than jointly executable price paths.
method.limits: One instrument, one historical sample, repeated percentage searches. Full-history compromise is picked after seeing all dates, maximizing profit among pairs with at least the old method both-fill count; it is hindsight and not independent validation. More fills also include more losing trades. No reliable future optimum is established. No trading source or settings changed.
